what: Production Kafka cluster (deploy/docker-compose.prod.yml): three KRaft brokers, SASL_SSL on every listener, StandardAuthorizer with deny-by-default, topics with replication factor 3 and min.insync.replicas=2. Security probes and a broker kill under load, run locally on 2026-10-24 (Docker Desktop, Windows).

setup.appConnection: API and consumer as flight_app over SASL_SSL: /api/health kafka up, /api/stream/status live

securityProbes.probe: plaintext client to the client listener (kafka1:9092)
securityProbes.result: refused: the CLI cannot speak to the TLS port (fails with 'Java heap space', the plaintext-client-on-TLS symptom)

securityProbes.probe: TLS + SASL as flight_app with a wrong password
securityProbes.result: refused: Authentication failed: Invalid username or password

securityProbes.probe: plaintext client to the controller listener (kafka1:9093)
securityProbes.result: refused, as on the client listener

brokerKillUnderLoad.load: stream:replay of 30,000 real December flights at 1,000/s (tools service, acks=all, idempotent producer)
brokerKillUnderLoad.kill: docker kill kafka2 after 14,168 events had arrived
brokerKillUnderLoad.afterRestartOfKafka2: rejoined; ISR 1,2,3 on all three partitions of flights.raw
brokerKillUnderLoad.reading: Every acknowledged event is on the cluster (sent = end offsets) and was consumed (committed = end) while one broker was down. The 2,065 redeliveries during leader failover were absorbed by the idempotent upserts (stream_flights unchanged, no duplicates).
